types.summary: Parsed shaderdef shader, plus runtime binding to a device/compiler once Create is called.

types.name: ShaderGlobal
types.summary: A global a pass reads, named by a global pragma with its GLSL type.

types.name: ShaderLibrary
types.summary: Shader files any include can reach by a name starting with "Graphite/".

types.name: ShaderParser
types.summary: Parses shaderdef markdown files into the core data types.

types.name: ShaderPass
types.summary: Render state, id metadata, source shaders, plus the variant set once its ShaderDefinition is created for a device.

types.name: ShaderProperty
types.summary: Default value a ShaderDef markdown file wants for a uniform or resource.

types.name: ShaderPropertyType
types.summary: Backing type a property was created with.

types.name: ShaderSnapshot
types.summary: Serializable snapshot of a shader: per-pass axes plus whatever variants are cached.

types.name: ShaderSurface
types.summary: A Surface block: the shading model it names, its code, the document line it starts on, and its Lighting and Vertex code.

types.name: Variant
types.summary: One fixed keyword combination plus whatever backend shader descriptions it's compiled for.

types.name: VariantScope
types.summary: Who picks the value of a variant axis.

types.name: VariantSpace
types.summary: A variant axis declared by a shader.

types.name: GlslCompilerOptions
types.summary: Settings for GlslShaderCompiler.

types.name: GlslProgram
types.summary: A compiled program variant.

types.name: GlslShaderCompiler
types.summary: Compiles GLSLPROGRAM passes to SPIR-V through Prism.

types.name: ShaderCompileException
types.summary: A shader failed to compile.

types.name: AimConstraintDefinition
types.summary: Turns one bone by the shortest turn so a chosen axis of it points at a target, optionally limited to a cone and weighted in.

types.name: AngleOp
types.summary: Angle-domain operations on a degrees input.

types.name: AnimationClip
types.summary: A skeletal animation clip storing one uncompressed transform per bone per key frame.

types.name: AnimationClipBase
types.summary: The playable part of a clip shared by every storage format: timing, root motion, sync track, events and secondary clips.

types.name: AnimationEvent
types.summary: A time-ranged animation event on a clip, in normalized clip time [0,1].

types.name: AnimationGraph
types.summary: An animation graph definition: node definitions, named control parameters and a root pose node.

types.name: AnimationGraphInstance
types.summary: A runtime instance of an AnimationGraph bound to a skeleton: per-node state plus a control parameter store.

types.name: AnimationPoseDefinition
types.summary: Samples a clip at a normalized time from a value node (a static pose, no playback).

types.name: AnimationValueType
types.summary: The data types a graph value node / control parameter can carry.

types.name: AnimatorBase
types.summary: The base of the animators: owns the working Pose, advances playback, and pushes the result out through hooks a host engine implements, such as ApplyBoneTransform.

types.name: Avatar
types.summary: The animation profile of a model: a Skeleton, as a generic rig or a humanoid one retargetable through muscle space.

types.name: AvatarBuilder
types.summary: Builds Avatar instances from a skeleton.

types.name: AvatarType
types.summary: How an Avatar drives a skeleton.

types.name: Blend1DDefinition
types.summary: Blends across N child pose nodes by a float parameter, picking the bracketing pair.

types.name: Blend2DDefinition
types.summary: Blends child pose nodes placed in a triangulated 2D parameter space, phase locked.

types.name: BlendSpace2D
types.summary: A triangulated 2D blend space.

types.name: Blender
types.summary: Pose blending: interpolative, masked and additive blends, plus root motion delta blending.

types.name: BoneFlags
types.summary: Per-bone flags carried by the skeleton.

types.name: BoneMask
types.summary: A weight in [0,1] per bone and per float channel, restricting blends to part of the skeleton.

types.name: BoneMaskBlendDefinition
types.summary: Lerps between two bone masks by a float parameter.

types.name: BoneMaskNodeDefinition
types.summary: A node that produces a BoneMask (a per-bone weight set).

types.name: BoneMaskNodeInstance
types.summary: A runtime node that produces a BoneMask, recomputed once per update id.

types.name: BoneMaskSelectorDefinition
types.summary: Selects one of several bone masks by an int parameter (clamped).

types.name: BoolLogicDefinition
types.summary: And/Or of two bools, or Not of one (B unused for Not).

types.name: BoundFloat
types.summary: A FloatInput after binding, which is how a node reads it each update.

types.name: BranchState
types.summary: Whether the nodes being updated feed the final result (active) or the losing side of a transition.

types.name: CachedValueDefinition
types.summary: Caches its input: on entry and on each rising edge of the sample input, or following it until its branch starts losing a transition.

types.name: CachedValueMode
types.summary: When a CachedValueDefinition takes its sample.

types.name: ChainIK
types.summary: General N-bone inverse kinematics using Cyclic Coordinate Descent (CCD).

types.name: ChannelBlendMode
types.summary: How a channel entry combines with the value already on the pose.

types.name: ChannelDriver
types.summary: One channel driven by a FloatChannelLayerDefinition.

types.name: CharacterMotionDefinition
types.summary: How the character itself is moving, read from the world transform the graph is handed each update, so a graph can blend by speed or lean into a turn without the game feeding those in.

types.name: CharacterMotionValue
types.summary: What a CharacterMotionDefinition reads off the character's own movement.

types.name: ClipCursor
types.summary: A clip playhead: normalized time plus the number of loops completed.

types.name: ClipNodeDefinition
types.summary: Plays a clip, looping or clamping, sampling events and root motion.

types.name: ClipPlayback
types.summary: Helpers for turning a clip time in seconds into a normalized [0,1] sample position.

types.name: CompressedAnimationClip
types.summary: A clip whose per bone tracks are quantized: constant channels are stored once, changing ones are range quantized per frame.

types.name: ConditionSelectorDefinition
types.summary: Selects the child whose bool condition is first true (priority order); a condition index of -1 is an always-true fallback.

types.name: ConstValueDefinition
types.summary: A constant value.

types.name: ControlParameterDefinition
types.summary: A graph input set from gameplay/script.

types.name: CopyConstraintDefinition
types.summary: Copies another bone's or a target's model space transform onto a bone, optionally with an offset.

types.name: CurveValueDefinition
types.summary: Shapes one value with an authored curve, so a designer can decide how an input maps to an output (how aim offset grows with speed, how a weight fades in) without touching the graph.

types.name: DebugPoseDefinition
types.summary: Passes a pose through to an inspector callback, and puts back the reference pose on any bone gone NaN.

types.name: DrivenChannelDefinition
types.summary: Drives a float channel from how far a bone has turned from its reference pose, about an axis or in total.

types.name: EasingOp
types.summary: Easing curves used by eased value nodes; None disables easing.

types.name: ExternalGraphSlotDefinition
types.summary: A slot a graph is plugged into at runtime via SetExternalGraph, playing its fallback while empty.

types.name: ExternalPoseDefinition
types.summary: A pose the host writes in each frame through Source and HasPose.

types.name: ExternalPoseInstance
types.summary: The runtime side of an ExternalPoseDefinition, which the host writes into.

types.name: FixedWeightBoneMaskDefinition
types.summary: A bone mask with a uniform fixed weight on every bone.

types.name: FloatAngleMathDefinition
types.summary: Angle-domain operations on a degrees input.

types.name: FloatChannelLayerDefinition
types.summary: Writes float channels onto its child's pose from graph values, leaving the bones alone.

types.name: FloatClampDefinition
types.summary: Clamps a float to a range.

types.name: FloatCompareDefinition
types.summary: Compares two float values, producing a bool.

types.name: FloatEaseDefinition
types.summary: Time-based eased follow of a float input toward its target using an easing curve.

types.name: FloatInput
types.summary: A number a node is built with: a fixed value, or a value node read every update.

types.name: FloatMathDefinition
types.summary: Combines two float values with an arithmetic operation.

types.name: FloatMathOp
types.summary: An arithmetic operation.

types.name: FloatRangeComparisonDefinition
types.summary: True when a float input lies within a range (inclusive or exclusive bounds).

types.name: FloatRemapDefinition
types.summary: Remaps a float from one range to another (extrapolating outside the input range).

types.name: FloatSelectorDefinition
types.summary: Outputs the float for the first true condition (priority order), optionally eased.

types.name: FloatSpringDefinition
types.summary: Follows another value under a spring.

types.name: FloatSwitchDefinition
types.summary: Picks one of two float inputs based on a bool selector.

types.name: FootEvent
types.summary: A foot contact/passing marker used for grounding and locomotion sync.

types.name: FootEventConditionDefinition
types.summary: True when any sampled foot event satisfies the configured phase condition.

types.name: FootGround
types.summary: The ground found under one foot, in character space.

types.name: FootGroundingDefinition
types.summary: Places the humanoid feet on the ground under them with FootPlacement: each foot moves by the ground's height rather than being pinned to it, the hips drop so both legs reach, and planted feet tilt ont

types.name: FootLockDefinition
types.summary: Pins a foot in world space while the lock input reads true, so it stops sliding.

types.name: FootPhase
types.summary: Which foot and phase a FootEvent marks.

types.name: FootPhaseCondition
types.summary: A foot-phase query used by foot-event condition nodes; the last two group two phases.

types.name: FootPlacement
types.summary: Humanoid foot placement: moves each foot by the height of the ground under it rather than pinning it there, so a lifted foot stays lifted.

types.name: FrameSnapMode
types.summary: How a SnapToFrameEvent region snaps the sampled time to a frame.

types.name: FrameTime
types.summary: A time position within an animation expressed as an integer frame index plus a fractional part in [0,1) through that frame.

types.name: GraphAnimator
types.summary: An animator driven by an AnimationGraph (state machines, blends, IK, sub-graphs).

types.name: GraphBindContext
types.summary: Wiring context passed once at instance creation to resolve child references.

types.name: GraphContext
types.summary: Per-update state passed to every node while evaluating a graph instance.

types.name: GraphNodeDefinition
types.summary: Base for a graph node's authored definition (config + child indices).

types.name: GraphNodeInstance
types.summary: Base for all runtime node instances.

types.name: GraphValidationException
types.summary: Thrown when a graph cannot be instantiated, carrying the offending node index.

types.name: HierarchicalBoneMaskDefinition
types.summary: Builds a bone mask by feathering authored seed weights (by bone id) down the hierarchy.

types.name: HumanBodyBone
types.summary: The standard humanoid bones: body bones first, then three phalanges per finger.

types.name: HumanBodyPart
types.summary: Coarse body regions for building a HumanPoseMask.

types.name: HumanDescription
types.summary: A humanoid mapping for one skeleton: which bone plays each HumanBodyBone, muscle range overrides and tuning values.

types.name: HumanGoal
types.summary: The four humanoid IK goals.

types.name: HumanGoalState
types.summary: A humanoid IK goal: the desired end effector transform plus how strongly position and rotation should be enforced.

types.name: HumanPose
types.summary: A skeleton independent humanoid pose in muscle space: the body position and rotation, one value per muscle mapping -1..1 onto its range, four IK goals and the look at.

types.name: HumanPoseBlender
types.summary: Muscle space operations on HumanPoses: muscles blend linearly, rotations by slerp.

types.name: HumanPoseMask
types.summary: A humanoid body part mask in muscle space: a [0,1] weight per humanoid bone (applied to that bone's muscles), per IK goal, and for the root.

types.name: HumanTrait
types.summary: Reference data about the humanoid rig: required bones, parents, names and the auto mapper's aliases.

types.name: HumanoidAutoMapper
types.summary: Recognises a humanoid rig in a skeleton: bone names are normalized, split into a side and a name, matched against GetNameAliases, then the topology is validated.

types.name: HumanoidClip
types.summary: A clip baked into muscle space, one HumanPose per frame, so it plays on any humanoid.

types.name: HumanoidMapResult
types.summary: The outcome of a humanoid auto mapping: the mapping, whether it is humanoid, and the bones it could not find.

types.name: HumanoidRig
types.summary: The humanoid bones bound onto a skeleton, plus what retargeting needs: scale, the bind body frame, axis frames and muscle ranges.

types.name: IBlendWeights
types.summary: How much of each input a blend is using right now, for an editor or a debug view.

types.name: IGroundProbe
types.summary: A way for a graph to ask the world where the ground is, in world space.

types.name: IKEffector
types.summary: A named IK effector: a bone chain (root..end) driven to a model space target.

types.name: IKEffectorInfo
types.summary: One effector of an IKRigDefinition: a bone chain driven to a target value node.

types.name: IKRig
types.summary: A multi effector IK rig: add effectors, set their targets, and solve them all in one pass.

types.name: IKRigDefinition
types.summary: Solves a multi effector IK rig over a child pose.

types.name: IStateMachineState
types.summary: What a state machine is doing, for an editor or a debug view.

types.name: IdComparisonDefinition
types.summary: True when an input id matches (or does not match) a set of ids.

types.name: IdEvent
types.summary: A named gameplay marker (footstep sound, hit frame, etc.).

types.name: IdEventConditionDefinition
types.summary: True when the sampled events contain the configured id event(s).

types.name: IdToFloatDefinition
types.summary: Maps an input id to a float via parallel id/value arrays, with a default.

types.name: InertializeDefinition
types.summary: Absorbs a pose discontinuity instead of cross fading through it: on a trigger, the gap to the new pose decays to zero over the blend time.

types.name: Inertializer
types.summary: Smooths over a pose discontinuity: the gap between the old and new pose, and its velocity, decay to zero over the blend time.

types.name: IsTargetSetDefinition
types.summary: True when the input target is set.

types.name: LayerBlendDefinition
types.summary: Blends layers over a base pose, each with its own weight, optional mask and additive flag.

types.name: LayerInfo
types.summary: One layer of a LayerBlendDefinition: a pose plus how it is applied.

types.name: LookAtDefinition
types.summary: Applies a humanoid look at on top of a child pose (requires an avatar).

types.name: LookAtSolver
types.summary: A humanoid look at: turns the spine, neck, head and eyes toward a model space target by yaw and pitch, so the head never rolls.

types.name: MakeAdditiveDefinition
types.summary: Turns a pose into an additive one, measured against the reference pose or another child's pose.

types.name: MatchTarget
types.summary: Steers root motion so a body part reaches a target by a point in the animation.

types.name: MirrorDefinition
types.summary: Mirrors a humanoid child pose left/right (passthrough for non-humanoid avatars).

types.name: MotionBinary
types.summary: Reads and writes skeletons, clips and humanoid descriptions as a compact binary stream.

types.name: MuscleAxis
types.summary: The component of a bone's rotation a muscle drives, in the bone's axis frame.

types.name: MuscleLayerDefinition
types.summary: Blends two poses in muscle space rather than bone by bone, optionally through a humanoid mask.

types.name: NoiseValueDefinition
types.summary: A smooth wandering value that repeats exactly for a given seed.

types.name: OrientationWarpDefinition
types.summary: Rewrites a clip's root motion so its travel heads toward a direction, or turns by an angle in degrees, spread over the clip's first OrientationWarpEvent.

types.name: OrientationWarpEvent
types.summary: A pure marker over the region where orientation warping applies.

types.name: OverrideLayerDefinition
types.summary: Blends an overlay onto a base by weight, optionally through a bone mask (override layer).

types.name: ParameterValue
types.summary: A tagged value flowing along the graph's value pins (control parameters, comparisons, math, etc.).

types.name: PassthroughDefinition
types.summary: Forwards a child pose unchanged (useful as a named wiring/insertion point).

types.name: PassthroughPoseNodeInstance
types.summary: A pose node wrapping a single child: forwards initialization, shutdown, timing and the sync track, so modifiers (speed scale, mirror, IK, root motion override) stay transparent to synchronized blends.

types.name: PlayMode
types.summary: How a clip behaves when its time passes the end.

types.name: PlaybackSpan
types.summary: A normalized playback step on a clip: the start and end times plus how many times playback wrapped (past the end going forward, past the start going backward) in between.

types.name: Pose
types.summary: A skeletal pose: parent-space transforms (the authority) plus a lazily computed model-space cache, a non-owning skeleton reference, and a PoseState.

types.name: PoseChannelDefinition
types.summary: Reads one float channel off a pose node as a graph value, so a weight or a speed authored into a clip can drive the rest of the graph.

types.name: PoseMirror
types.summary: Mirrors humanoid poses left to right in muscle space, across the bind body frame's sagittal plane.

types.name: PoseNodeDefinition
types.summary: A node that produces a pose.

types.name: PoseNodeInstance
types.summary: A runtime pose node.

types.name: PoseSmoothingDefinition
types.summary: Eases the output toward its child by a half life in seconds, independent of frame rate.

types.name: PoseSnapshotDefinition
types.summary: Passes a child through until its hold input turns true, then keeps the pose captured at that moment.

types.name: PoseState
types.summary: The semantic state of a Pose.

types.name: PoseTransferMode
types.summary: How an ExternalPoseDefinition brings a pose onto the graph's own skeleton.

types.name: Quantization
types.summary: Track quantization: 16 bit range encoding for translation and scale, and 48 bit smallest three encoding for rotations.

types.name: RandomSelectorDefinition
types.summary: Plays a child picked at random by weight, and picks again each time it finishes.

types.name: ReferencePoseDefinition
types.summary: Outputs the skeleton's reference (bind) pose.

types.name: ReferencedGraphDefinition
types.summary: Plays another AnimationGraph as a child, forwarding parent value nodes into its named control parameters.

types.name: Retargeter
types.summary: Converts between a skeleton Pose and the muscle space HumanPose.

types.name: RootMotion
types.summary: Per-frame root motion: the transform of the character root across the clip.

types.name: RootMotionBlendMode
types.summary: How two root motion deltas are combined.

types.name: RootMotionChannels
types.summary: Which parts of a root motion delta survive a RootMotionFilterDefinition.

types.name: RootMotionEvent
types.summary: Marks a region where a root-motion-override node should suspend its override (let the clip's own root motion play through).

types.name: RootMotionFilterDefinition
types.summary: Keeps only part of a clip's root motion: strip the turn from a clip that drifts, hold a character at a fixed height, or drop translation entirely to play a travelling clip on the spot.

types.name: RootMotionOverrideDefinition
types.summary: Scales/clamps a child's root motion.

types.name: RootMotionOverrideOptions
types.summary: Options for Override.

types.name: RootMotionUtil
types.summary: Applies a root-motion delta to a world transform to move a character.

types.name: RootMotionWarp
types.summary: Root motion overriding and warping.

types.name: SampledEvent
types.summary: An event sampled during an update, with how strongly and from which branch it was sampled.

types.name: SampledEventRange
types.summary: A contiguous half open range [Start, End) of events in a SampledEventsBuffer.

types.name: SampledEventsBuffer
types.summary: Collects the events sampled over one update and answers simple queries.

types.name: SelectorDefinition
types.summary: Outputs one of N child pose nodes chosen by an int value node (clamped to the valid range).

types.name: SequenceDefinition
types.summary: Plays its children one after another, then loops or holds the last one.

types.name: SimpleAnimator
types.summary: A lightweight animator that plays clips with cross fades, without a graph.

types.name: Skeleton
types.summary: An immutable shared skeleton: parallel arrays of bone ids, parent indices, and a parent-space reference pose, plus a derived model-space reference pose.

types.name: SkeletonLOD
types.summary: Skeleton level of detail.

types.name: SkeletonMapping
types.summary: Matches the bones and float channels of two skeletons by id, so a clip plays on another rig that shares its bone names.

types.name: SnapToFrameEvent
types.summary: Marks a region that should be sampled discretely (snapped to a frame).

types.name: SpeedScaleDefinition
types.summary: Scales the play rate of a child by a float value node (or a constant), clamped to 0 or more.

types.name: SpringBonesDefinition
types.summary: Gives a chain of bones, listed root outward, world space secondary motion: each lags behind the animated pose and settles back under a spring.

types.name: StateInfo
types.summary: A state in a state machine: a content pose node plus its outgoing transitions.

types.name: StateMachineDefinition
types.summary: A state machine: states and the transitions that cross fade between them when their condition is true.

types.name: StateQuery
types.summary: What a StateQueryDefinition reports about a state machine's active state.

types.name: StateQueryDefinition
types.summary: Reads a state machine's time in state or normalized progress.

types.name: StaticBoneMaskDefinition
types.summary: A mask built ahead of time for the skeleton the graph runs on, such as one from an asset.

types.name: StrideWarpDefinition
types.summary: Matches a clip's travel to a desired speed by scaling its playback rate.

types.name: StringID
types.summary: A hashed string identifier for bone, event and parameter names, which keeps the original string.

types.name: SyncEvent
types.summary: A sync event: a named marker at a normalized start time in [0,1) along a clip, with its duration.

types.name: SyncTrack
types.summary: Maps normalized clip time to sync event time (event index plus fraction) and back, so two clips blend in phase.

types.name: SyncTrackTime
types.summary: A position within a sync track: an event index plus the fraction through that event.

types.name: SyncTrackTimeRange
types.summary: A start and end position on a sync track, used to drive synchronized updates.

types.name: Target
types.summary: A target: a world transform, or a named bone with an optional offset.

types.name: TargetInfo
types.summary: The scalar a TargetInfoDefinition extracts from a target.

types.name: TargetInfoDefinition
types.summary: Extracts a scalar (angle, distance, or delta orientation euler) from a target, measured in character space.

types.name: TargetOffsetDefinition
types.summary: Folds a fixed rotation/translation offset into a bone target.

types.name: TargetPointDefinition
types.summary: Returns the translation (point) of a target as a vector.

types.name: TargetWarpDefinition
types.summary: Rewrites a clip's root motion so it ends on a character space displacement or a world Target.

types.name: TargetWarpEvent
types.summary: Marks a region where target (position) warping applies.

types.name: TargetWarpRule
types.summary: Which axes a TargetWarpEvent region warps.

types.name: TimerValueDefinition
types.summary: Seconds since the node started playing, optionally wrapped to a loop length or normalized over it.

types.name: TransformChannels
types.summary: Which parts of a source transform a CopyConstraintDefinition takes.

types.name: TransitionEasing
types.summary: Shapes the 0..1 transition blend weight over time.

types.name: TransitionEvent
types.summary: Marks a region of a clip with a rule controlling whether the state machine may transition away from it.

types.name: TransitionEventConditionDefinition
types.summary: Reads the most restrictive TransitionEvent rule sampled this frame and answers a rule question (e.g.

types.name: TransitionInfo
types.summary: A transition out of a state: a target state, a bool condition node (-1 = always), and a blend duration.

types.name: TransitionRule
types.summary: How restrictive a TransitionEvent region is.

types.name: TransitionRuleCondition
types.summary: The question a transition-event condition asks of the most restrictive rule found.

types.name: TransitionSync
types.summary: How the target state's time is aligned to the source when a transition starts.

types.name: TurnWarpDefinition
types.summary: Scales a turn on the spot clip's root rotation so it turns by an angle in degrees, read when the node starts.

types.name: TwistDistributionDefinition
types.summary: Spreads a driver bone's roll about the limb axis across twist bones, each by its share.

types.name: TwoBoneIK
types.summary: Analytic two bone IK: turns the upper and mid bones so the end reaches a model space target, bending in the plane the input pose already bends in unless a pole is given.

types.name: TwoBoneIKDefinition
types.summary: Applies two bone IK on top of a child pose, driving the end bone to a goal value (a model space Vector or a Target).

types.name: ValueInputKind
types.summary: The value types a node input accepts.

types.name: ValueNodeDefinition
types.summary: A node that produces a typed value.

types.name: ValueNodeInstance
types.summary: A runtime value node.

types.name: VectorCreateDefinition
types.summary: Builds a vector from three float values.

types.name: VectorInfoDefinition
types.summary: Extracts a component or the length of a vector value as a float.

types.name: VectorNegateDefinition
types.summary: Negates a vector value.

types.name: VelocityBlendDefinition
types.summary: A 1D blend whose thresholds are derived from each child clip's average linear root speed, driven by a desired-speed float parameter.

types.name: WeightedBlendDefinition
types.summary: Blends any number of poses by normalized weights.

types.name: WeightedPose
types.summary: One input of a WeightedBlendDefinition: a pose and the value node weighting it.

types.name: ZeroPoseDefinition
types.summary: Outputs the zero (additive-identity) pose.

types.summary: Registry mapping attribute types to their handlers.

types.summary: Fluent builder for a breadcrumb navigation trail.

types.summary: A single segment in a breadcrumb trail.

types.name: BreadcrumbSeparator
types.summary: Style of separator drawn between breadcrumb segments.

types.summary: Direction the chat bubble tail points toward.

types.name: BuiltInFieldDrawers
types.summary: Registers all built-in field drawers into the given registry.

types.name: ButtonBuilder
types.summary: Fluent builder for an Origami button.

types.name: ButtonContext
types.summary: Per-frame state passed to a custom button renderer.

types.name: ButtonGroupBuilder
types.summary: Segmented control — a row of buttons where one is selected.

types.name: ButtonGroupStyle
types.summary: Visual style for a button group / segmented control.

types.name: ButtonStyle
types.summary: Visual style for an Origami button.

types.summary: Plain C# without a compiler: lexical highlighting, brace folding and C# indentation rules.

types.summary: Hand written C# lexer for instant highlighting with no compiler behind it.

types.name: CaretStyle
types.summary: How the caret is drawn.

types.summary: Fluent builder for a chat bubble widget.

types.name: CodeCompletionCommit
types.summary: What committing a completion does to the document.

types.summary: Line based text buffer behind a CodeEditor.

types.name: CodeEditKind
types.summary: Why an edit happened.

types.summary: A virtualized code editor: the state, commands and language plumbing behind CodeEditor.

types.summary: Per frame builder for a CodeEditor.

types.name: CodeEditorColors
types.summary: Colours of a CodeEditor.

types.summary: An action of the code editor that can be bound to a key.

types.name: CodeEditorDiagnostic
types.summary: A diagnostic placed in the document.

types.summary: A key with the modifiers that must be held for it.
